label: New audit reproduction; not historical training or GPU hardware measurements
gpu_allocation_method: Integrate (4 - available_before_event) * elapsed over FIFO step trace. Fixed per-job resources and runtimes make total GPU-time policy-invariant. Divide by 4 * makespan. This is reservation occupancy, not physical utilization.
throughput_method: Completed jobs / makespan in abstract simulation time units
notes: One fixed workload, no confidence interval. Actual runtimes, IDs, and arrivals matched across all policies; no RL or EDF evaluation.
